steps.content: You estimate that the bottom of the pit is around thirty to forty meters deep. Containers and cranes are scattered down below, making the place look like a secret warehouse or a bizarre maze.
The lightless night and slowly flowing sand provide excellent cover, yet the flickering red light at the bottom of the pit makes the crypt look deep and dangerous.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Are you sure it's here?

steps.speaker: Tall and Thin Man
steps.content: Positive. This place is very easily concealed. That's why it took us so long to find the clues.
A lanky man stands behind Zoya. His left leg is making some mechanical operation sound. It's a prosthetic.

steps.speaker: Tall and Thin Man
steps.content: The ambushed party down there is not of a small scale. All the gangsters still alive have probably teamed up and are preparing for the final battle.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Just some wounded sidekicks, they're not gonna change anything.

steps.speaker: Tall and Thin Man
steps.content: You should worry about the <color=#fb9259>inheritance</color> itself.

steps.speaker: Tall and Thin Man
steps.content: If we're right, where it lies is also the center of the Mania.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Quit stressing out, Earl. Look at you, you've got so much white hair you can be the dad of the entire Legion.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Don't worry about the contamination. I've taken precautions.
You're dragged before Zoya.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: It's this inheritance that can control Mania and set off this crisis.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Even the Legion wants it.
The <color=#fb9259>inheritance</color>, the unknown waves of energy crashing in the depths of the earth. It gives you an entirely different sensation than SALVA's underground facility.
All these people chasing after this evil power—Ted, the gangsters, and the commander in front of you—all seem like villains to you.

options: Stop it, you can't tolerate the contamination

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I know. That's why you're still alive.

options: You want us to go down for you?
I want no part in your gang feuds.

steps.content: She's going to hide in a safe place and let you and the Sinners take the risk —You feel a hint of despise for the fearsome commander for the first time.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Haha, that's the authorities' style. That's not the way the Legion does things.
You resent corrupt, violent cycles like this, and you hate to become their tool.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Haha, I know you're not willing. Even if this place turns into hell, the authorities will never give a damn.
She suddenly grabs your left hand, slamming you onto the truck behind.
As you begin to struggle, your forehead takes a heavy blow, shaking your entire skull. Next thing you know, she presses her forehead to yours, nailing you firmly onto the metal surface.
At that moment, you clearly recognize the burning violence and passion in her eyes. But somewhere deeper, there's an icy flame, a rage that's been frozen to the core for a long time.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: We're not like you, the Legion never runs away from fights.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I will crush every enemy with my own hands, and I will do that by whatever means I can find, including you.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Come on, Chief, use your shackles on me.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You can suppress contamination, can't you? Then serve me.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Suppress my power with your shackles. Otherwise, your wrist is going to get crumbled.
Extreme pain and confusion are hitting you hard. You can vaguely hear Hecate's shouts, see the two figures running toward you, and see Zoya dart her gaze to the side to glance at them.
Feeling real fear at that moment, you instinctively grab her wrist with your right hand and feel your palm begin to burn...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Hmm.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Let him go!

The massive power gripping your wrist loosen. Your legs feel weak and you sit onto the ground, collapsing. Hecate and Hella rush to you in time, holding your arms to support you. But right now, even the Nightmare is terrified.

Having achieved her purpose, the fearsome commander acts as if nothing has happened. She shakes her right hand, now branded with the shackles, clenches her fist, and stares down at you, seeming amused.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Hmm... I'll admit the reason behind your move is kinda cute.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Alright, what's done is done, cut the grumbles.

steps.speaker: Tall and Thin Man
steps.content: ...How does it feel to be restrained?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Nothing special. I need to try it to see.
When she finishes, she casually scoops up a worn sedan on the side and smashes it straight behind an abandoned container. Some startled shouts come out from there.
Apparently, a group of gangsters has been hiding there for a while. Having been spotted, they can only toughen up and charge.

steps.speaker: Ambushing Gangsters
steps.content: Set off the flare to have them get ready down there! We'll slow her down!

steps.speaker: Ambushing Gangsters
steps.content: We can't let the Legion take the inheritance!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Good timing, come and be my sandbags. Let me see how these shackles can enhance my power.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Hey, you two, protect your chief. Before I go down, he can't die.
steps.female_content: Hey, you two, protect your chief. Before I go down, she can't die.
